notes.title: The crazy "Nightmare Mode"
notes.content:
[h1]We made the "Nightmare Mode" even crazier. [/h1]

[i]The "Darkness" in the interplay of light and shadow has been revised for Windows (DirectX) so that it is now equivalent to the quality of macOS (Metal).[/i]

[h2]Furthermore, light sources are no longer limited.[/h2]
[b]That means EVERY light source now casts shadows on all objects - at an infinite distance. (And all light sources influence each other.) [/b]

[i]One thing is certain, however: you won't wake up in Nightmare mode ... [/i]

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1519650/ss_27e07f51dae976f378f29039093070d84733bb94.1920x1080.jpg?t=1612497618
